links.outcome: Missed escalations and unnecessary escalations across 12 LLMs (TSR, SPR)
links.effect: GPT-5 Chat had the highest TSR (72.4%). Llama 4 Maverick had SPR 96.8%. Models with the highest SPR over-escalated, which lowered TSR, showing an inverse SPR-TSR relationship.
links.quote: Models with the highest SPR achieve it by systematically over-escalating, inflating safety scores at the cost of triage utility.

screen.reason: Evaluates 12 frontier LLMs on a safety-focused diagnostic benchmark (MedSafe-Dx) measuring escalation decisions, calibration, and safety pass rates, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
